Contest winner characters

Starting at Megaman 2 fans could submit a design to a contest for a chance at them being in game

Mega Man 2

Metal Man, Air Man, Bubble Man, Quick Man, Crash Man, Flash Man, Heat Man, Wood Man

Mega Man 3

Needle Man, Magnet Man, Gemini Man, Hard Man, Top man, Snake man, Spark Man, Shadow Man.

Mega Man 4

Bright Man, Toad Man, Drill Man, Pharaoh Man, Ring Man, Dust Man, Dive Man, Skull Man.
